profile.headline: Software Developer at Epic Systems
profile.summary:
I am a Software Developer with Epic Systems. I love that the work I do at Epic improves the healthcare experience of millions of patients across the US as well internationally.

I recently won 1st place in the University Rover Challenge, in June 2023, with an incredible team of WVU Engineers. Read more about it here: https://www.wdtv.com/2023/06/08/wvu-robotics-team-wins-international-competition/.

Languages/Formats: Python, Java, C/C++, Bash, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, MATLAB, LaTeX
Experienced With: Linux, Microcontrollers, Qt, AWS, Bootstrap, JavaFX, Electron, Maven, Gradle, ROS, Robotics

Check out my portfolio at shubhpatel18.github.io
View my general resume at https://shubhpatel18.github.io/assets/resume/Resume_General.pdf

Contact me for more information at shubhp18@gmail.com

honors.title: University Rover Challenge 1st Place
honors.description:
As a member of Team Mountaineers, we secured 1st place out of 104 teams, including 37 finalists from 10 countries, in a competition held at the Mars Desert Research Station in Utah.

I developed the autonomous navigation software for our rover, Wanderer, and was responsible for its communications equipment and user interface.
